item.title: Tornado St. Louis: Nearly a Year Later, Recovery Stalls as New Warnings Sound
item.description:
Tornado St. Louis: Nearly a Year Later, Recovery Stalls as New Warnings Sound

Key Takeaways:

  • The May 16, 2025 EF-3 tornado killed 5 people, damaged over 5,000 structures, and caused an estimated $1.6 billion in damage
  • Nearly 11 months later, many neighborhoods remain littered with broken windows, blue tarps, and untouched homes
  • New tornado watches and warnings were issued for the St. Louis area on April 15–16, 2026, renewing fears
  • New documents reveal why the cleanup has been so painfully slow
  • Federal aid has been requested but remains pending

As tornado watches flash across the St. Louis region once again this week, residents are experiencing a grim sense of déjà vu. On the evening of April 15, 2026, KMOV issued a First Alert Weather Day with a tornado watch for parts of the area through midnight. By Wednesday night, tornado warnings were issued for Franklin County and parts of Gasconade and Crawford County.
